public_source_update.paper: Godin & Thivierge, PLOS Computational Biology 2026, DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719, published 2026-08-25
source_facts: The paper states that SPLiT uses online Oja subspace tracking plus normalized LMS in manifold coordinates and re-orthonormalizes the tracked basis every 1 ms.

The final rotational-drift section describes a gradual coordinate rotation Q(t+dt)=Q(t)R(dtheta), and reports that frozen U stays poorly aligned while adaptive U improves alignment and error in S11/S12.
S1 Code remains publicly linked as Code.zip, but binary source contents were still not recoverable through the available read-only transport in this invocation.
public_source_update.scope: public paper text only; no O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, or cross-role semantic input

bounded_audit.purpose: Separate the printed within-span right rotation from a genuine ambient subspace rotation while keeping N=100, k=3, gradual 0-to-80-degree drift, online Oja subspace tracking, normalized LMS decoder learning, and matched latent/observation noise across paired seeds.

design.readout: scalar linear target from three latent components

conditions.printed_right_rotation: Q(t)=Q0 R(theta), so span(Q) is invariant
conditions.explicit_ambient_rotation: Q_i(t)=cos(theta) Q0_i + sin(theta) Qperp_i for matched orthogonal complement directions

comparators: adaptive Oja U + normalized LMS decoder
frozen initially aligned U=Q0 + normalized LMS decoder
oracle current Q(t) + normalized LMS decoder

bounded_audit.interpretation: In this bounded linear control, a frozen aligned k-dimensional basis loses no ambient subspace information under the paper's printed right rotation and performs near oracle; noisy adaptive Oja tracking is slightly worse. When the same 80-degree schedule genuinely rotates the ambient subspace, frozen decoding degrades sharply and Oja adaptation recovers most of the loss, though it remains above oracle error. This directly supports online subspace tracking as useful for genuine ambient drift while reinforcing that the printed Q@R rotational suite is not itself a clean test of that regime.
limits: Not the authors' RNN, feedback loop, exact drift schedule, exact update ordering, or S8/S11/S12 reproduction.
Per-step eta semantics remain code-dependent because the paper text and prior parameter table observations leave a timestep/update-rate ambiguity until S1 Code is inspected.
The control does not establish Oja-specific superiority over generic subspace trackers; earlier bounded controls found generic adaptive PCA can match or exceed Oja in some drift regimes.
Do not generalize the synthetic MSE effect sizes to the published task.

candidate_update.positive_scope: Adaptive low-dimensional subspace tracking has a clear mechanistic advantage when the represented ambient subspace actually rotates and a frozen aligned basis loses signal.
candidate_update.negative_scope: Under pure within-span Q@R coordinate rotation, an already aligned frozen full-rank basis retains the subspace; published S11/S12 therefore require additional empirical/code-level semantics before serving as direct evidence for ambient-manifold tracking.
